_about: Garathorm Wall: the walk along the top of the city wall. The night watch walks it in two halves; a sergeant keeps each far turn; gulls and crows ride the wind; a cutpurse uses the wall as a road over the rooftops.
no_boss: the city's wall walk: the watch keeps it

40300.name: wall watchman sentry
40300.long_desc: A sentry of the wall paces the battlements, spear in hand, watching the plains.
40300.description: A wind-burned soldier in a quilted coat and steel cap, a spear and a horn at the hip. From up here the watch sees trouble coming long before it reaches the gates.

helpers.shout: The sentry winds his horn: the wall is under attack!

40301.name: sergeant wall
40301.long_desc: A sergeant of the wall stands at the turn of the battlements, barking orders.
40301.description: Grizzled and broad, with a crossbow slung across his back and a short sword at his belt. He has held this turn of the wall for twenty winters.

40302.name: gull grey
40302.long_desc: A grey gull perches on a merlon, screaming at the wind.
40302.description: A big, bold, yellow-eyed gull that has learned the sentries carry bread.

40303.name: crow carrion
40303.long_desc: A carrion crow hops along the parapet, watching you with one black eye.
40303.description: Glossy black and clever, the crows of the wall pick over whatever the gulls leave.

40304.name: cutpurse rooftop
40304.long_desc: A rooftop cutpurse crouches in the shadow of a merlon.
40304.description: Lean and soft-footed, dressed in dark grey, a thin knife at the wrist. The wall is the quickest road over the city for those who do not want to be seen in the streets.

40390.room_desc: A watchman's ash spear lies here.
40390.description: A plain ash shaft as tall as a man, capped with a leaf-shaped steel head and wrapped in cord where the hand goes. The wall watch carry them on every turn of the battlements.

40391.room_desc: A brass watch horn lies here.
40391.description: A curled brass horn on a leather baldric, dented from many falls on stone. One long blast calls the next tower; three short ones call the whole wall.

40392.short_desc: a steel cap of the watch
40392.room_desc: A steel cap of the watch lies here.
40392.description: A round steel cap with a padded lining and the city's tower stamped on the brow. It is cold to wear in the wind off the plains.

40393.room_desc: A sergeant's short sword lies here.
40393.description: A broad, heavy-bladed short sword with a worn brass guard, kept sharp through twenty winters on the wall. It was made for close work on a narrow parapet.

40394.room_desc: A cutpurse's thin knife lies here.
40394.description: A slim blade no longer than a finger, honed on both edges, made for slitting purse strings rather than throats.

40395.room_desc: A heel of watch bread lies here.
40395.description: A hard heel of the dark bread the sentries carry in their coats. The gulls have learned to wait for it.
